title: Beyond Self-Reflection: An Execute-Distill-Verify Framework for Agentic Experience Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.24428v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Experience learning lets large language model agents reuse lessons through external memory without updating model parameters. However, reflection can endorse execution errors and store them as future guidance, a failure mode we call the Self-Confirmation Trap. We propose EDV, an Execute-Distill-Verify framework for offline experience construction. Heterogeneous agents independently execute each task; a third-party distiller compares their trajectories and environmental feedback to extract candidate lessons; and the executors separately review each candidate, retaining only unanimously approved lessons. Evaluation uses a single solver retrieving from the frozen memory bank. Experiments on $\tau^2$-bench, Mind2Web, and MMTB show improved revisited-task performance, with additional evidence of within-domain transfer to held-out tasks on $\tau^2$-bench. On an annotated Retail subset, EDV reduces the Self-Confirmation Trap Rate from 11.0%

translated_title: 超越自我反思：一种用于智能体经验学习的执行-提炼-验证框架
translated_abstract: 经验学习使大语言模型智能体能够通过外部记忆复用经验教训，而无需更新模型参数。然而，反思过程可能会认可执行错误并将其存储为未来指导，我们将这种失败模式称为“自我确认陷阱”。我们提出了EDV，一个用于离线经验构建的执行-提炼-验证框架。异构智能体独立执行每个任务；第三方提炼器比较它们的轨迹和环境反馈以提取候选经验教训；执行者分别审查每个候选经验，仅保留获得一致通过的经验。评估采用从冻结记忆库中检索信息的单一求解器。在τ²-bench、Mind2Web和MMTB上的实验表明，重访任务的性能得到提升，并有额外证据表明在τ²-bench上可实现向保留任务的域内迁移。在一个带标注的Retail子集上，EDV将自我确认陷阱率从11.0%（原文截断）
tldr: 提出EDV框架，通过异构智能体独立执行任务、第三方提炼器提取候选经验、执行者一致验证的方式构建离线经验，有效避免了大语言模型智能体在自我反思中将执行错误固化为指导的“自我确认陷阱”问题。
en_tdlr: EDV is an Execute-Distill-Verify framework that avoids the Self-Confirmation Trap by having heterogeneous agents independently execute tasks, a third-party distiller extract candidate lessons from their trajectories, and executors unanimously verify lessons before storing them in memory.
